what: Ten pages for late December and January: spousal open work permit (IRCC, modified 2026-06-12), bridging open work permit (2026-06-23), PGWP (2026-06-24), Express Entry 2026 review (IRCC rounds), PR fees (IRCC fee list, 2026-09-21), Atlantic Immigration Program (2026-09-22), Nova Scotia Nominee Program (Live in Nova Scotia, selections updated 2026-08-17), New Brunswick PNP rounds (GNB, updated automatically), Rural Community Immigration Pilot (IRCC, 2026-04-30) and a citizenship test practice from Discover Canada.

NOC code finder with the 516 occupations and 27,935 job titles of Statistics Canada's NOC 2021 Version 1.0 (Open Government Licence), TEER descriptions from IRCC (page modified 2025-06-27) and the occupations of the 2026 Express Entry categories.

British Columbia: BC PNP Skills Immigration registration score from the program guide effective 2026-05-28, and the 2026 BC PNP invitations and registration pool from WelcomeBC (page updated 2026-10-08), refreshed every 3 hours.
Super visa minimum necessary income (IRCC table updated 2025-07-29) and parents and grandparents sponsorship income for the 2025 intake (IRCC page modified 2025-07-28).

Federal Skilled Worker 67-point grid and Canadian Experience Class requirements from IRCC's program pages (modified 2026-09-24), with education points from IRCC's education credential assessment page.
Alberta: Worker EOI points grid from Alberta's PDF dated 2026-09-28 and the 2026 AAIP draws from the AAIP processing information page (updated 2026-10-07), now read automatically.

Saskatchewan: International Skilled Worker points grid from the SINP eligibility page and the 75 EOI selections in Saskatchewan's results document (updated 2024-09-12). Both are checked daily for changes.
Manitoba: Expression of Interest ranking grid from the MPNP EOI page (updated 2026-10-02) and every EOI draw notice published by Manitoba (256 draws, read automatically).

Ontario: scoring grid of the new Ontario Workforce Priority stream from Ontario's stream page (updated 2026-10-06, including the 5 October earnings change), and every OINP invitation round published since 2021 from Ontario's invitations page (updated 2026-08-11), now read automatically.

Rules added for upcoming tools: proof of funds amounts from IRCC's proof of funds page (amounts updated 2025-07-07) and citizenship physical presence rules from IRCC's citizenship eligibility page (modified 2026-04-21) and IRCC's physical presence calculator FAQ. The physical presence calculator reproduces IRCC's own worked example (1,129 days). A daily check now flags any change in the IRCC pages behind our rules.

New page: Express Entry categories, with the requirement and the occupation list (NOC 2021 and TEER) of each of the 10 current categories, from IRCC's category-based selection page (modified 2026-06-22). Category draw pages now show their 2026 requirement. Added the researchers category to the draws data.

Calculator tested against IRCC's online calculator with 1,000 random profiles: 917 identical; the other 83 differ only because IRCC's calculator gives 0 points to TCF Canada at NCLC 4 while the published criteria give 6 per ability. The calculator now flags that case. New pages: CLB 4 to 10 and NCLC 4 to 10, and the CRS score distribution.
Launch version. CRS rules from IRCC's CRS criteria page (modified 2026-06-22), language equivalences from IRCC's language test page, draws history to round #448 (2026-10-13).
